logo.name: Logo and favicon
logo.logo_inverse_info: Light version shown when the header sits over a hero image.
logo.logo_mobile_info: Optional. Falls back to the main logo.
logo.logo_max_height_info: Keeps tall logos from pushing the header icons.

colors.name: Colors
colors.drawer_color_scheme_info: Cart drawer, mobile menu, filters and search.

typography.name: Typography
typography.custom_font_info: Upload a .woff2 in Content → Files and paste its file name. Overrides the font above.
typography.letter_spacing_info: In thousandths of the font size (-75 to 250).

layout.name: Layout
layout.section_spacing_info: Scales the top and bottom padding of every section.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.corner_cut_info: Cuts the top-right corner diagonally for a technical look. 0 = off.

product_cards.name: Product cards
product_cards.card_image_fit_info: "Fit" keeps cut-out product photos whole; "Fill" crops lifestyle photos to the shape.
product_cards.show_rating_info: Needs a reviews app that fills the standard rating metafields.
product_cards.badge_new_days_info: 0 = off. Uses each product's publish date.
product_cards.swatch_type_info: Variant pictures use each colour's variant image; colours without one show a colour chip.
product_cards.badge_sold_out_position_center: Centred at the bottom of the image
product_cards.card_countdown: Show a sale countdown on cards
product_cards.card_countdown_info: Only for products whose date metafield holds a future end date (type "Date and time"). Nothing is shown without a real date.

swatches.name: Color swatches
swatches.map_info: One per line, "Name: #hex", for option values that are not plain colour names. Swatches set in admin take priority.
swatches.option_names_info: Options with these names show colour chips (separate names with commas). Options whose values have swatches in Shopify admin always do.
swatches.map_info_images: One per line: "Name: #hex", "Name: file-name.jpg" (a picture uploaded in Content → Files) or "Name: https://…" (full image link). Swatches set in Shopify admin take priority.
swatches.image_preview_info: Picture swatches show a larger version with the value's name when hovered or focused.

animations.name: Animations
animations.reveal_info: Always off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
animations.images: Fade in images as they load
animations.page_transitions_info: Cross-fades between pages in supporting browsers. No extra script.

currency.name: Currency
currency.code_info: E.g. $14.61 USD. Useful when selling in several currencies.

cart.name: Cart

free_shipping_thresholds.label: Free shipping thresholds
free_shipping_thresholds.info: One amount per currency, e.g. "USD:50, EUR:45". A plain number applies to your store currency. Leave blank to hide the progress bar. The free shipping rate itself is set in Settings → Shipping.

cart.show_note: Show order note in cart drawer

show_terms.label: Require agreement to terms before checkout
show_terms.info: Adds a checkbox to the cart drawer and cart page. Accelerated checkout buttons are hidden on the cart page while this is on.

show_recommendations.label: Show recommendations in cart drawer
show_recommendations.info: Based on the first product in the cart.

empty_collections.label: Collections to show
empty_collections.info: Shown as tiles when the cart drawer is empty.

advanced.name: Performance
advanced.prefetch_info: Browsers fetch the next page while the pointer rests on a link. Skips cart, checkout and account.

placeholder.label: Placeholder text
placeholder.info: Leave blank for the default "Search products…".

menu.label: Suggested links
menu.info: Menu shown before the shopper types. Items with sub-links become groups.

predictive.label: Show results while typing
predictive.info: Products, collections, pages, articles and query suggestions.

heading_highlight.label: Heading highlight
heading_highlight.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

media.overlay_info: Add blocks (heading, text, button) to show text on top of the video.

card_quick_add.label: Show quick add on product cards
card_quick_add.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

card_show_highlights.label: Show spec icons on product cards
card_show_highlights.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

card_rating_chip.label: Show rating on the card image
card_rating_chip.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

menu.label: Menu
menu.info: Edit menus in Online Store → Navigation. Three levels open as a wide panel.

settings.logo_hint: The logo is set in Theme settings → Logo and favicon.

active_style.label: Current page indicator
active_style.info: Also shown when hovering a menu item.

menu_button_label.label: Menu button label
menu_button_label.info: Shown next to the menu icon from 750px up. Leave blank for the icon only.

drawer_show_social.label: Show social icons in the menu drawer
drawer_show_social.info: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

show_account.label: Show account
show_account.info: Only when customer accounts are turned on.

show_country_selector.label: Show country/region selector
show_country_selector.info: Appears only when the store sells in more than one country or language.

transparent_color_scheme.label: Transparent header colors
transparent_color_scheme.info: Used over the first section when it allows a transparent header (Hero → Transparent header). Only its text color is used; upload a light logo in Theme settings → Logo.

legal_text.label: Legal notice
legal_text.info: Trademark, licensing or company registration text shown under the copyright line.

show_policy_links.label: Show policy links
show_policy_links.info: Refund, privacy, terms, shipping and contact pages from Settings → Policies.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave empty to use "Page not found" in the store's language.

text.label: Message
text.info: Leave empty to use the default message in the store's language.

menu.label: Popular links
menu.info: Pick a menu from Online Store → Navigation.

menu_heading.label: Popular links heading
menu_heading.info: Leave empty to use the menu's name.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave empty to show the store name.

text.label: Message
text.info: Leave empty to use the message from Online Store → Preferences → Password protection.

consent_text.label: Consent line
consent_text.info: Short note under the form, e.g. that people can unsubscribe at any time. Link your privacy policy here.

color_scheme.info: Used when there is no background image.

show_footer.label: Show footer (Powered by Shopify, owner login)

settings.hint: Cart options (free shipping, note, terms, recommendations, empty cart) are in Theme settings → Cart.

free_shipping_position.label: Free shipping progress
free_shipping_position.info: Set the amount in Theme settings → Cart.

show_recommendations.label: Show product recommendations
show_recommendations.info: Uses the recommendation settings in Theme settings → Cart.

gift_wrap_product.label: Gift wrap product
gift_wrap_product.info: Shows a "Gift wrap this order" checkbox that adds one of this product. Create it as a product with a price (and hide it from collections).

gift_wrap_message.label: Ask for a gift message
gift_wrap_message.info: Saved with the order as a cart attribute.

show_shipping_estimator.label: Show shipping estimate
show_shipping_estimator.info: Shoppers enter a country and postal code to see your shipping rates.

show_discount.label: Show discount code field
show_discount.info: Several codes can be combined when your discounts allow it.

media_width.label: Image column width
media_width.info: Share of the row the images take on screens 1280 px and wider. Between 750 and 1279 px the details column keeps a readable width and the images take the rest.

media_ratio.label: Image shape
media_ratio.info: "Match first image" gives every slide the first image's shape. "Each image's own shape" lets the slider grow and shrink with the current image.

gallery_layout.label: Desktop gallery layout
gallery_layout.info: Phones always show a swipeable slider.

thumbnail_position.label: Thumbnails
thumbnail_position.info: Beside: a scrollable column at the start of the large image. None: dots under the image.

enable_zoom.label: Open images in full-screen zoom
enable_zoom.info: Shoppers can zoom with a click, tap, pinch or the mouse wheel.

variant_media_only.label: Show only the selected variant's images
variant_media_only.info: Hides images attached to other variants. To give a variant several images, start their alt text with a tag, e.g. "#Color:Black | Side view" — tagged images show only while that value is selected; untagged images always show.
variant_media_only.info_tags: Hides images attached to other variants. To give a value several images, end their alt text with a tag, e.g. "Side view #color:black". Several values: "#color:black,blue"; several options: "#color:black,size:large". Tagged images show only while a listed value is selected; untagged images always show. The tag is not read out to screen readers. The older form "#Color:Black | Side view" still works.

video_autoplay.label: Autoplay videos
video_autoplay.info: Uploaded videos play muted while visible; not for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

sticky_cart.label: Show sticky add-to-cart bar
sticky_cart.info: Appears at the bottom of the screen once the Add to cart button scrolls out of view.

media_width_percent.label: Custom image column width
media_width_percent.info: 30% is under a third of the row, 50% half, 75% three quarters.

sticky_info.label: Keep the shorter column in view while scrolling
sticky_info.info: Desktop: the details column (or the images, in the slider layout) stays below the header while the page scrolls.

zoom_mode.label: Zoom style
zoom_mode.info: Magnifier: with a mouse, clicking an image shows it at 2× where the pointer is (click again or move away to close). Touch screens and keyboard open the full-screen viewer.

zoom_mobile_button.label: Magnifier button on phones
zoom_mobile_button.info: Phones show a small magnifier button on each image that opens the zoom; tapping the image itself only swipes.

enable_filters.label: Enable filters
enable_filters.info: Choose filters with the Search & Discovery app.

header_image.label: Header image
header_image.info: Leave empty to use the collection's own image.

show_breadcrumb.label: Show breadcrumb
show_breadcrumb.info: Home › Collections › collection name, also shared with search engines.

transparent_header.label: Transparent header over the banner
transparent_header.info: Works when this section is first on the page. Set the header colors in Header → Transparent header colors.

header_color_scheme.label: Header colors
header_color_scheme.info: Text colors on the banner, or the colors of the text panel beside the image.

subcollection_source.label: Subcollection links
subcollection_source.info: Menu: the links under the current collection in that menu (or its siblings), up to three levels deep.

subcollections.label: Collections
subcollections.info: Used when Subcollection links is "Chosen collections". The same links show on every collection that uses this template.

subcollection_menu.label: Menu
subcollection_menu.info: Usually the main menu. Only links to collections are used.

enable_density_toggle.label: Show column switch
enable_density_toggle.info: Lets shoppers choose how many products per row on desktop. The choice is remembered.

pagination.label: Pagination
pagination.info: With "Load more" and infinite scroll, shoppers without JavaScript still get a link to the next page.

promo_when_filtered.label: Keep promo tiles while filtering
promo_when_filtered.info: Promo tiles show on the first page only.

filter_layout.label: Filter layout
filter_layout.info: On phones and tablets filters always open in a drawer.

position.label: Position in the grid
position.info: The tile appears before this product on the first page. If there are fewer products, it goes at the end.

column_span.label: Width
column_span.info: On phones the tile always takes the full row.

image_mobile.label: Mobile image
image_mobile.info: Optional. Used on screens narrower than 750px.

video.label: Video
video.info: Plays muted in a loop, with a pause button. Replaces the image; the image becomes the cover.

button_label.label: Button label
button_label.info: Leave empty to make the whole tile the link (image tiles).

show_type_tabs.label: Show result type tabs
show_type_tabs.info: "All / Products / Blog posts / Pages" links under the search box.

suggestions_menu.label: Popular searches menu
suggestions_menu.info: Links shown before a search and when nothing matches. Point them at search pages or collections.

empty_collection.label: Products to show when nothing matches
empty_collection.info: Shown under the "no results" message. Leave empty to show nothing extra.

layout.label: Desktop layout
layout.info: Carousel shows one row with previous / next buttons beside the heading. Mobile follows "Mobile layout".

image_mobile.label: Mobile image
image_mobile.info: Optional. Use a portrait image for phones.

video.label: Background video
video.info: Plays muted on loop instead of the image.

text_surface.label: Text colors
text_surface.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

transparent_header.label: Transparent header
transparent_header.info: When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of it without a background.

full_width.label: Full width
full_width.info: Off: the banner sits inside the page width with rounded corners.

color_scheme.label: Background around the banner
color_scheme.info: Color scheme of the space around the banner when it is not full width.

image_style.label: Image style
image_style.info: "Overlapping images" layers a smaller second image over the first, both slightly rotated.

second_image.label: Second image
second_image.info: Smaller image placed over the first one. Shows a placeholder until you choose one.

image_rotation.label: Rotation
image_rotation.info: How far the two images lean in opposite directions. 0 keeps them straight.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: "Card" joins image and text into one rounded card with a colored text panel.

note.label: Small print
note.info: E.g. a link to your privacy policy.

autoplay.label: Change automatically
autoplay.info: A pause button is always shown next to the messages.

show_arrows.label: Show arrows
show_arrows.info: Always shown when messages do not change automatically.

marquee_duration.label: Time for one full loop
marquee_duration.info: Higher is slower. The marquee pauses on hover and focus, and stays still for reduced motion.

show_social.label: Show social icons
show_social.info: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

autoplay.label: Change slides automatically
autoplay.info: A pause button is always shown. Shoppers who prefer reduced motion must press play first.

accessibility_label.label: Slideshow description
accessibility_label.info: Read by screen readers, e.g. "Current promotions". Leave empty for "Slideshow".

height.info: "Adapt to image" uses the first slide's image.

color_scheme.info: Colors of the slide controls and the space around the slides.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: "Peek" insets the current slide with rounded corners and shows a sliver of the previous and next slides at the sides.

video.label: Shopify video
video.info: Upload in Content → Files. Used instead of the video link.

video_url.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
video_url.info: Used when no Shopify video is chosen. Embedded without tracking cookies where possible.

cover_image.label: Cover image
cover_image.info: Shown until the video plays. Shopify videos use their own preview image when empty.

description.label: Video description
description.info: Tells screen reader users what the video shows.

autoplay.label: Autoplay (muted)
autoplay.info: Plays muted after the page has loaded. Never on data-saver or slow connections, or for shoppers who prefer reduced motion. A pause button is always shown.

transparent_header.info: Banner mode (full width) only. When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of the video without a background.

image_after.label: After image
image_after.info: Use a different photo of the same scene, taken from the same angle and with the same size.

label_color_scheme.label: Divider and label colors
label_color_scheme.info: Pick a scheme that stands out on your images.

settings.grid_info: Tiles sit on a 12-column grid. Set each tile's width (columns) and height (rows) in the tile settings.

image_mobile.info: Optional. When set, hotspots use their mobile positions on phones.

hotspot_color_scheme.label: Hotspot colors
hotspot_color_scheme.info: Pick a scheme whose background stands out on your image.

speed.label: Speed
speed.info: Pixels per second. Stops on hover, on keyboard focus and with the pause button; static for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

twin_rows.label: Add a second row
twin_rows.info: A second row of the same images moves the other way. Hidden for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.info: Rotates the strip for a more dynamic look. 0 keeps it straight.

start_size.label: Starting window size
start_size.info: How much of the image shows before scrolling. Older browsers and reduced motion show the full image at once.

color_scheme.info: Background around the image while it opens.

show_tag_filter.label: Show tag filter
show_tag_filter.info: Lists every tag used in this blog. Scrolls sideways on phones.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: Collage: the first post large with its text over the image and the next two beside it (first page only; phones always stack).

show_tags.label: Show tags
show_tags.info: Optional: give an article a color metafield custom.tag_color to color its tags.

show_comments.label: Show comment count
show_comments.info: Only when comments are enabled for the blog.

show_excerpt.label: Show excerpt
show_excerpt.info: Write an excerpt when editing the post; otherwise the first words of the post are used.

lead_text_scheme.label: Text colors on the first post
lead_text_scheme.info: Used over the image of the large first post in the collage.

meta_icons.label: Show icons in the date line
meta_icons.info: Calendar and clock icons before the date and reading time.

fallback_image.label: Fallback image
fallback_image.info: Only used for posts that have no featured image of their own.

show_share.label: Show share links
show_share.info: Networks follow Theme settings → Social media. Hidden when you add a Share block to this section.

comments_per_page.label: Comments per page
comments_per_page.info: Comments appear only when they are enabled for the blog (Online Store → Blog posts → Manage blogs).

header_alignment.label: Title alignment
header_alignment.info: Start: tags and date on one line above the title.

transparent_header.label: Transparent header over the banner
transparent_header.info: Only when this section is the first on the page.

content_overlap.label: Post body overlaps the banner
content_overlap.info: The text area starts with rounded corners over the bottom of the banner.

toc.label: Table of contents
toc.info: Built from the post's headings; hidden when the post has fewer than two.

show_progress.label: Show reading progress bar
show_progress.info: A thin bar at the top of the window fills as the visitor reads.

show_author_box.label: Show author box
show_author_box.info: Name, photo and bio of the staff account that wrote the post (Settings → Users).

footer_style.label: Share, next post and comments
footer_style.info: Panel groups them on a light tinted background below the post.

share_comments_count.label: Show comment count beside share links

prev_next_meta.label: Show date and author on previous / next posts

blog.label: Blog
blog.info: Leave empty on blog post pages to show more posts from the same blog. Elsewhere the section stays hidden until a blog is chosen.

exclude_current.label: Leave out the post being read

related_first.label: Show posts with the same tags first

show_view_all.label: Show "View all" link
show_view_all.info: Appears only when the blog has more posts than shown.

lead_text_scheme.label: Text on the large post
lead_text_scheme.info: Pick a scheme whose text color stands out on your images.

collections.label: Collections
collections.info: Leave empty to show every collection.

sort.label: Sort collections
sort.info: With all collections, sorting applies within each page.

feature_first.label: Show the first collection over its image
feature_first.info: Makes the first tile stand out, e.g. "All products" with a photo.

enable_shop_login.label: Show "Sign in with Shop"
enable_shop_login.info: Requires Shop Pay to be active for the store.

settings.fields_info: Add "Registration field" blocks to ask for more details. Answers are saved in the customer's note.

consent_text.label: Terms / privacy note
consent_text.info: Shown above the button. Link your privacy policy or terms here.

test_mode.label: Test mode
test_mode.info: Shows on every page load and in the editor, ignoring the frequency. Turn off before going live.

frequency_days.label: Show again after
frequency_days.info: Days after a visitor closes it. Visitors who sign up are not asked again for a year.

button_label.label: Button label
button_label.info: Leave empty for "Sign up" in the store's language.

image.label: Image
image.info: Shown beside the text on tablets and desktops only.

position.label: Position
position.info: On phones the popup always slides up from the bottom.

test_mode.info: Shows on every page load, ignoring earlier confirmations. Turn off before going live.

frequency_days.label: Ask again after
frequency_days.info: Days after a visitor confirms. Only an explicit confirmation is remembered.

decline_url.label: Leave button link
decline_url.info: Where visitors go when they are not of age. Leave empty to show a message instead.

settings.info: Shows only to visitors who must be asked for consent (for example in the EU) and have not answered. Turn off Shopify's own banner in Settings → Customer privacy to avoid showing two.

test_mode.info: Shows on every page load for everyone, and in the editor. Turn off before going live.

privacy_url.label: Privacy policy link
privacy_url.info: Leave empty to use the store's privacy policy.

show_preferences.label: Show "Manage preferences"
show_preferences.info: Lets visitors choose analytics, marketing and personalization cookies separately.

settings.hint: Shown only on phones. Add up to six items.
Search options are in Theme settings → Search.

settings.info: Shows the products this shopper opened on this device (stored in their browser only). Hidden until there is something to show.

products.label: Products
products.info: Up to 4. Rows come from each product's specification metafield.

metafield.label: Specification metafield
metafield.info: namespace.key of a multi-line text metafield with one "Label: Value" per line. The Specifications block reads the same field.

sticky_header.label: Keep product names visible while scrolling

alignment.label: Content alignment on desktop
alignment.info: Positions the blocks. Heading and text blocks also have their own text alignment.

structured_data.label: Output FAQ structured data
structured_data.info: Adds FAQPage data for search engines, built only from the questions and answers in this section. Turn on only when every answer is real and current.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: Card: the questions and the contact panel share one rounded card in the section color scheme.

contact_form.label: Show a contact form
contact_form.info: Messages go to the store's customer-service email through Shopify's contact form.

group_style.label: Category style
group_style.info: How "Category" blocks look. "Cards" puts each category and its questions in a bordered card.

group_links.label: Show category links
group_links.info: A row of links above the questions that jump to each category.

settings.genuine_notice: Only publish genuine quotes from real customers, with their permission. Never invent reviews, names or ratings.

heading_end.label: Heading, second line
heading_end.info: Shown on its own line at the end side, under the heading.

grayscale.label: Show logos in grayscale
grayscale.info: Logos turn to color on hover and keyboard focus.

show_nav.label: Show date buttons
show_nav.info: Desktop only. Each button jumps to its milestone.

card_style.label: Milestone style
card_style.info: "Image beside text" works best with one milestone visible on desktop.

peek.label: Show part of the next milestone
peek.info: Desktop only. Hints that the row can be scrolled.

animate.label: Count up when shown
animate.info: Runs once. Visitors who prefer reduced motion see the final number.

separator.label: Separator
separator.info: Added after each phrase, unless the phrase already ends with its own separator.

twin_rows.label: Add a second row
twin_rows.info: Repeats the phrases in the opposite direction, as decoration.

settings.real_deadline_notice: Use only for a real deadline. The timer counts to the date and time below in your store's time zone (Settings → General) and never restarts.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31. An invalid date shows no timer.

end_time.label: End time
end_time.info: 24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 18:00. Leave empty for midnight.

ended_message.label: Ended message
ended_message.info: Replaces the timer after the deadline. Leave empty to show nothing.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: Use the bar in the header group for a slim site-wide strip.

color_scheme.info: With a background image, pick a scheme whose text contrasts with the image.

show_view_all.label: Show "View all" link to all collections

settings.delivery_notice: Messages go to the customer support email in Settings → Store details. Shopify adds spam protection automatically.

success_message.label: Success message
success_message.info: Leave empty for the default thank-you message.

privacy_note.label: Privacy note
privacy_note.info: Shown under the form, e.g. a link to your privacy policy.

details.label: Contact details
details.info: Shown beside the form: email, phone, hours, address. Connect shop metafields to keep them in one place.

heading_tag.label: Heading tag
heading_tag.info: Use H1 when this is the first heading on the page.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: "With map" shows a map of the store address beside the form; contact details go below.

details_style.label: Contact details style
details_style.info: Applies to the details text and the "Contact detail" blocks.

field_labels.label: Field labels
field_labels.info: "Inside the fields" shows each label as placeholder text; screen readers still read the label.

map_height.label: Minimum map height on desktop
map_height.info: The map grows with the form next to it.

text.label: Text
text.info: Words fill with color one after another as the shopper scrolls. Press Enter for a new line.

split.label: Fill step
split.info: "Automatic" fills word by word, or character by character for text without spaces (Chinese, Japanese).

start_opacity.label: Starting color strength
start_opacity.info: How visible the text is before it fills. Shoppers who prefer reduced motion see full color.

image.info: The first image block replaces [image1] in the text, the second [image2], and so on.

text.label: Text
text.info: Type [image1], [image2] … where the image blocks should appear. Images without a placeholder follow the last word. Italic words get the heading highlight.

image_height.label: Image height
image_height.info: Relative to the text size, so images shrink with the text on mobile.

badge_text.label: Badge text
badge_text.info: Written around a slowly turning circle on the gallery. Leave empty to hide. Repeat short text to fill the circle, e.g. "New release • New release • ". Decorative: screen readers skip it and it stays still for visitors who reduce motion.

settings.discount_info: The theme only collects the products — it never changes prices. To give the bundle a discount, create an automatic discount in Shopify admin → Discounts (for example "Buy 3 items from these products, get 30% off") and describe it in the note below.

max_items.label: Maximum items
max_items.info: Raised to the minimum when set lower.

allow_duplicates.label: Allow the same product more than once
allow_duplicates.info: Off: a product can be added once (any one of its variants).

note.label: Note
note.info: Short promise under the heading, e.g. "Add 3 products to save 30%". Only promise a discount you have created in admin.

video.label: Video
video.info: Shopify-hosted video. The tile shows the image (or the video's preview image); the video plays in the post window.

link.label: Link to the original post
link.info: Shown as "View post" in the post window and opens in a new tab.

account_handle.label: Account name
account_handle.info: For example @yourstore. Shown next to the Follow button and in every post window.

follow_link.label: Follow button link
follow_link.info: Your profile on the social network. Opens in a new tab.

platform_icon.label: Network icon
platform_icon.info: Shown on the tiles, the Follow button and the "View post" link.

tile_text_scheme.label: Icons on tiles
tile_text_scheme.info: Pick a scheme whose text color stands out on your photos.

role.label: Role or title
role.info: Shown under the name, e.g. "Lead designer".

bio.label: Bio
bio.info: Cards show the first words; the side panel shows all of it.

page.label: More content from a page
page.info: Added below the bio in the side panel. Edit it in Online Store → Pages.

drawer_image.label: Show the image in the side panel

heading_position.label: Heading position on desktop
heading_position.info: "Beside the cards" keeps the heading and button in view while the cards scroll past.

card_action.label: Card button opens
card_action.info: "Link" goes to the person's link (for example their profile page) instead of opening the side panel.

layout.info: "Staggered" shows two columns with the left one set lower; phones show a simple stack.

settings.intro: A slim bar at the edge of the screen with your social links (Theme settings → Social media) and a tab that opens the newsletter popup.

show_social.label: Show social links
show_social.info: Uses the links in Theme settings → Social media.

tab_label.label: Tab label
tab_label.info: Opens the newsletter popup when it is on for this page. Leave empty to hide the tab.

tab_link.label: Tab link
tab_link.info: Used when the newsletter popup is off or not shown on this page. Without a link the tab then stays hidden.

hide_on_scroll.label: Hide while scrolling down
hide_on_scroll.info: Comes back as soon as shoppers scroll up.

hide_social_on_mobile.label: Hide social links on mobile
hide_social_on_mobile.info: Keeps the bar small so it does not cover content.

show_on.label: Show on
show_on.info: The bar floats over the page edge; on pages with sidebars (collection filters) "Home page only" keeps it off the content.

target.label: Target
target.info: Id of an element on the page, or a section's key in the template (e.g. faq). Several separated by commas count as one link; the first is where it scrolls to.

sticky.label: Stay in view below the header
sticky.info: The bar follows the page while scrolling.

specs.label: Specs
specs.info: One per line: "Label: value". Lines starting with "-" add another value under the line above.

metafield.label: Product metafield
metafield.info: namespace.key of a multi-line text or list metafield written the same way. When the product has it, it replaces the specs above, so one template serves every product.

single_open.label: Open one group at a time

settings.box_info: Add "In-the-box item" blocks to show this card beside the specs.

box_sticky.label: Keep the card in view while scrolling (desktop)

image.label: Image
image.info: Wipes in over the media panel when this step is reached. Without one, the current picture stays.

image.label: Starting image
image.info: Shown before the first step image, and as the video cover.

video.label: Video
video.info: Plays muted in a loop instead of the starting image (with a pause button).

card_position.label: Info card position on desktop
card_position.info: The card appears when the section has blocks.

tag.label: HTML tag
tag.info: For SEO. Does not change the look.

custom_liquid.label: Liquid code
custom_liquid.info: Only classes listed in CLASS_VOCAB.md are styled here.

inline_price.label: Show price next to the title
inline_price.info: Use instead of a separate Price block. Follows the selected variant.

swatches.label: Show colour options as swatches
swatches.info: Uses the swatch colours set in admin, or the colour name.
swatches.info_names: Colour options show colour chips: options whose values have swatches in Shopify admin, and options named in Theme settings → Color swatches. Chip colour: admin swatch, then Theme settings colour names, then the value's name.

image_swatches.label: Show variant images as swatches
image_swatches.info: Each value shows the image of its variant (set variant images in admin). Values without an image show as buttons.
image_swatches.info_fallback: Each value shows the image of its variant (set variant images in admin). Values without an image show a colour chip (colour options) or a button.

image_swatch_options.label: Options with image swatches
image_swatch_options.info: Option names separated by commas. Leave empty to use the first option.

show_dynamic_checkout.label: Show accelerated checkout buttons
show_dynamic_checkout.info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay and other wallets set up in Settings → Payments.

show_price.label: Show price in the Add to cart button
show_price.info: For example "Add to cart · $99.00". Follows the selected variant.

key.label: Metafield key
key.info: Multi-line text metafield, one "Label: Value" per line.

image.info: Leave empty to use the collection image.

title.label: Title
title.info: Leave empty to use the collection title.

link.info: Leave empty to link to the collection.

custom_icon.label: Custom icon
custom_icon.info: Replaces the built-in icon. Square SVG or PNG.

mobile_accordion.label: Collapse on mobile
mobile_accordion.info: Needs a heading. From 750px up the links are always shown.

video.label: Background video
video.info: Shopify video, plays muted on loop while the slide is shown. Replaces the image.

link.label: Link for the whole slide
link.info: Makes the entire slide clickable. Leave empty if the slide has buttons.

link_label.label: Link description
link_label.info: Read by screen readers. Leave empty to use the slide heading.

video_autoplay.label: Autoplay (muted)
video_autoplay.info: Plays muted while visible, with a pause button. Otherwise shoppers press play.

image.info: Video cover, or replaces the product / collection image.

heading.label: Title
heading.info: Leave empty to use the product or collection title.

link_label.label: Link description
link_label.info: Read by screen readers when the tile has no title.

column_span.label: Width (columns)
column_span.info: Out of 12 columns on desktop. 6 = half, 4 = a third.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.info: A short line under the title.

product.info: Leave empty to show a note (title, text, link) instead.

settings.mobile_info: Used only when the section has a mobile image.

image_mobile.info: Optional. Shown on phones instead of the image.

text.label: Caption
text.info: Shown under the image. Without an image the tile shows this text large.

label.label: Label
label.info: Shown to customers and used as the name of the answer in the customer note.

checked_value.label: Value when ticked
checked_value.info: Saved in the customer note when the box is ticked. Nothing is saved when it is not.

options.label: Choices
options.info: Separate choices with commas, e.g. Friend, Search, Social media.

menu_item.label: Menu item
menu_item.info: Title of a top-level item in the header menu, or its position (1 = first). The position keeps working if the item is renamed or translated.

text_mobile.label: Text on mobile
text_mobile.info: Optional shorter text for small screens.

settings.hint: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

image.label: Logo image
image.info: SVG or PNG with a transparent background works best.

name.label: Brand name
name.info: Used as alt text and link name for screen readers.

consent.label: Consent or privacy line
consent.info: Shown under the field, e.g. a link to your privacy policy.

settings.hint: Channels are chosen in Theme settings → Social media → Share buttons. Phones use their own share sheet.

settings.info: Uses Shopify's real inventory. Shows nothing for variants whose inventory is not tracked.

low_stock_threshold.label: Low stock threshold
low_stock_threshold.info: At or below this quantity, show "Only N left". 0 = always show "In stock".

show_incoming.label: Show incoming stock date
show_incoming.info: When the variant is out of stock and a transfer with a date is on its way.

settings.info: Needs a reviews app that fills the standard product rating metafields. Hidden when there are no reviews.

anchor.label: Link to reviews anchor
anchor.info: Id of the reviews element on the page, without #. Leave empty for no link.

show_label.label: Show custom labels
show_label.info: From the product metafield custom.label (single line text, or a list for several labels).

metafield.label: End date metafield
metafield.info: namespace.key of a product "Date and time" metafield. Hidden when empty or in the past.

metafield.label: Metafield
metafield.info: namespace.key of a list of single line text, one "icon: text" per entry, e.g. "truck: Ships in 24 hours".

settings.blocks_info: Row mode: add up to 6 icon rows. Metafield mode ignores the rows and reads each product's own list.

page.label: Page
page.info: Its title and content show in a side panel. Edit it in Online Store → Pages.

settings.info: Shows pickup locations from Settings → Shipping and delivery → Local pickup. Hidden when no location offers pickup for the selected variant.
Set pairs in the Search & Discovery app → Recommendations → Complementary products. Hidden when there are none.

products.label: Add-on products
products.info: Up to 4. Shoppers tick the ones they want and add them together.

include_current.label: Include this product
include_current.info: Lists the product on the page first, in the selected variant.

link.info: The heading and image link here. Add a link label to also show a text link.

label.label: Accessible label
label.info: Read by screen readers. Needed when the icon is a link or carries meaning on its own.

answer.label: Answer
answer.info: Connect a product or page metafield to reuse one answer on several templates.

role.label: Role or location
role.info: For example a city. Write "Verified buyer" only when you checked the order.

rating.label: Star rating
rating.info: Only the rating this customer actually gave.

label.label: Date or label
label.info: For example a year. Also used on the date buttons.

image.label: Image
image.info: Also used as the cover for a YouTube / Vimeo video.

number.label: Number
number.info: Type it exactly as it should read, e.g. 150K+, $2.5M, 4.8/5, 98%.

label.label: Tab label
label.info: Leave empty to use the collection title.

field_name.label: Name in email
field_name.info: Optional. Keeps answers under the same name in your inbox when you reword the label.

orientation.label: Direction
orientation.info: Vertical is for horizontal groups; it turns horizontal on mobile.

video_url.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
video_url.info: Used when no Shopify-hosted video is selected. The player loads only after a click.

poster.label: Cover image
poster.info: For YouTube / Vimeo links. Without one, a plain panel with the video description shows.

description.label: Video description
description.info: Names the video and its play button for screen readers.

autoplay.label: Autoplay muted
autoplay.info: Shopify-hosted video only. Plays while on screen; never for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

metafield.info: namespace.key of a list of single line texts or a multi-line text, one tile per line "value|label|icon", e.g. "38h|Battery life|battery". Icons: battery, bluetooth, bolt, headphones, speaker, mic, waves, weight, plug, ruler, clock, water, shield, leaf, star, box, globe, check.

placement.label: Placement
placement.info: "Below the images" works in the main product section on desktop; on phones the block follows the product info.

native_share.label: Show device share button
native_share.info: Opens the phone's or computer's own share menu where the browser supports it.

settings.help_info: Add Pop-up link blocks inside this block to open a page (help, size guide) in a side panel.

address.label: Address
address.info: Street address or place name as you would type it into Google Maps. No API key needed.

image.label: Fallback image
image.info: Shown when no address is set, and as the preview when the map loads on click.

load_on_click.label: Load map on click
load_on_click.info: Shows the fallback image with a "Show map" button; nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor presses it. Useful where cookie consent is required.

text.label: Text
text.info: Address, email or phone links, opening hours. Use line breaks for several lines.

show_social.label: Show social media icons
show_social.info: Links from Theme settings → Social media.
